q25386.en: If the power steering does not work properly, the steering becomes "heavy".

explain.short: Power steering helps you turn the wheel. Without its help you must use more force, so the steering feels heavy.
explain.rule: Power steering only makes the wheel lighter to turn. If it fails, steering becomes heavy, not easier; the hydraulic type needs the engine running.
explain.trap: 'pesante' (heavy) is right: a broken power steering makes the wheel harder, not easier, to turn.

sceneParams.caption: Power steering fault: heavy steering

q25387.en: If a tyre is punctured, the steering pulls in the direction of the flat wheel.

explain.short: A flat tyre slows its own wheel and the car leans on it, so the car pulls towards that side.
explain.rule: With a flat tyre the car pulls towards the side of the flat wheel. Hold the wheel firmly, do not brake hard and slow down gently.
explain.trap: 'della ruota forata' (of the flat wheel) is right: the pull is TOWARDS the flat tyre, not away from it.

sceneParams.caption: Flat tyre: the car pulls to that side
lines: Car pulls towards the flat wheel

q25388.en: For road safety, you must regularly check that the steering has no abnormal play.

explain.short: Play (gioco: free movement) in the steering makes the car react late and badly, so it must be checked regularly.
explain.rule: Steering is precise only if it has no play, the wheels are well aligned and balanced, tyres are at the right pressure and suspension is in good order.
explain.trap: 'giochi anomali' means abnormal play (looseness) in the steering, not games.

sceneParams.caption: Check the steering for play regularly

q25389.en: "Hard" steering can be a sign of low tyre pressure.

explain.short: A soft tyre has more rubber on the road, so the wheels are harder to turn. Heavy steering can mean low pressure.
explain.rule: Steering is precise only if it has no play, the wheels are well aligned and balanced, tyres are at the right pressure and suspension is in good order.
explain.trap: 'può essere indice' (can be a sign): low pressure is one possible cause, not the only one.

sceneParams.caption: Hard steering: check tyre pressure

q25390.en: Hydraulic power steering does not work if the engine is off.

explain.short: The hydraulic pump of the power steering is driven by the engine. Engine off means no help, so the wheel is very heavy.
explain.rule: Power steering only makes the wheel lighter to turn. If it fails, steering becomes heavy, not easier; the hydraulic type needs the engine running.
explain.trap: 'idraulico' (hydraulic): this type needs the running engine to work.

sceneParams.caption: Engine off: no hydraulic power steering

q25391.en: Too much play in the steering makes the vehicle's path imprecise.

explain.short: With play, the wheels do not follow the steering wheel at once, so the car does not go exactly where you want.
explain.rule: Steering is precise only if it has no play, the wheels are well aligned and balanced, tyres are at the right pressure and suspension is in good order.
explain.trap: 'giochi' here means looseness in the steering parts.

sceneParams.caption: Steering play: imprecise path

q25392.en: Wheel alignment (toe) affects how precisely the vehicle steers.

explain.short: If the wheels are not well aligned, they do not point the same way, so the car steers badly and the tyres wear out.
explain.rule: Steering is precise only if it has no play, the wheels are well aligned and balanced, tyres are at the right pressure and suspension is in good order.
explain.trap: 'convergenza' is the wheel alignment (toe), the angle of the wheels seen from above.

sceneParams.caption: Wheel alignment affects steering

q25393.en: If the steering vibrates, you should have the balance of the front wheels checked.

explain.short: The steering is linked to the front wheels. If they are not balanced, they shake and the steering wheel vibrates.
explain.rule: Steering is precise only if it has no play, the wheels are well aligned and balanced, tyres are at the right pressure and suspension is in good order.
explain.trap: 'anteriori' (front) is right: the steering moves the FRONT wheels.

sceneParams.caption: Vibrating steering: balance the front wheels
lines: Check balance of the front wheels

q25394.en: Power steering helps you keep control of the vehicle's path if a tyre is punctured.

explain.short: With a flat tyre the car pulls to one side. Power steering makes it easier to hold the wheel and keep the car straight.
explain.rule: With a flat tyre the car pulls towards the side of the flat wheel. Hold the wheel firmly, do not brake hard and slow down gently.
explain.trap: 'aiuta' (helps): it makes correcting easier, it does not stop the puncture.

sceneParams.caption: Power steering helps after a puncture
lines: Flat tyre: car pulls to one side

q25395.en: Power steering improves the vehicle's braking.

explain.short: Power steering only helps you turn the wheel. It has nothing to do with the brakes.
explain.rule: Power steering only makes the wheel lighter to turn. If it fails, steering becomes heavy, not easier; the hydraulic type needs the engine running.
explain.trap: 'azione frenante' (braking): power steering is for steering, not for braking (that is the servofreno, brake booster).

sceneParams.caption: Power steering does not help braking

q25396.en: If a tyre is punctured, the steering pulls in the direction opposite to the flat wheel.

explain.short: The car pulls TOWARDS the flat wheel, not away from it.
explain.rule: With a flat tyre the car pulls towards the side of the flat wheel. Hold the wheel firmly, do not brake hard and slow down gently.
explain.trap: 'opposta' (opposite) is the trick: the pull is towards the flat wheel.

sceneParams.caption: Flat tyre: pulls towards it, not away

q25397.en: If the steering vibrates, you must have the balance of the rear wheels checked.

explain.short: The steering is linked to the FRONT wheels, so a vibrating steering wheel means checking the front wheels, not the rear ones.
explain.rule: Steering is precise only if it has no play, the wheels are well aligned and balanced, tyres are at the right pressure and suspension is in good order.
explain.trap: 'posteriori' (rear) is wrong: it should be 'anteriori' (front).

sceneParams.caption: Vibrating steering: front wheels, not rear

q25398.en: A power steering failure shows itself as steering that is too easy to turn.

explain.short: When power steering breaks, the wheel becomes heavy and hard to turn, not too easy.
explain.rule: Power steering only makes the wheel lighter to turn. If it fails, steering becomes heavy, not easier; the hydraulic type needs the engine running.
explain.trap: 'eccessiva facilità' (too easy) is the opposite of the truth: it becomes heavy.

sceneParams.caption: Power steering failure: heavy, not easy

q25399.en: The steering wheel must be held in its lower part, with both hands under the spokes.

explain.short: Hold the wheel in the upper half, hands at 'quarter to three'. Holding it low gives poor control.
explain.rule: Hold the wheel with both hands at 'quarter to three' (left hand at 9, right hand at 3). Most wheels can be adjusted in height and depth.
explain.trap: 'parte bassa' (lower part) and 'sotto le razze' (under the spokes) are both wrong.

sceneParams.caption: Hands at quarter to three, not low
lines: Hands low, under the spokes: no

q25400.en: The steering wheel cannot be adjusted in height.

explain.short: Most cars have a steering wheel you can adjust in height (and often in depth) to find a good driving position.
explain.rule: Hold the wheel with both hands at 'quarter to three' (left hand at 9, right hand at 3). Most wheels can be adjusted in height and depth.
explain.trap: 'non può' (cannot) is wrong: many steering wheels can be adjusted.

sceneParams.caption: The steering wheel can be adjusted

q25401.en: Steering precision is not affected by the bad condition of the suspension and shock absorbers.

explain.short: Worn suspension and shock absorbers let the wheels bounce and lose grip, so steering becomes less precise.
explain.rule: Steering is precise only if it has no play, the wheels are well aligned and balanced, tyres are at the right pressure and suspension is in good order.
explain.trap: 'non è influenzata' (is not affected) is wrong: worn suspension does affect steering.

sceneParams.caption: Worn shock absorbers affect steering

q25402.en: Steering precision is affected by low lubricating oil pressure.

explain.short: Engine oil pressure is about lubricating the engine. It has nothing to do with how precisely the car steers.
explain.rule: Steering is precise only if it has no play, the wheels are well aligned and balanced, tyres are at the right pressure and suspension is in good order.
explain.trap: 'olio di lubrificazione' is the engine oil: it does not act on the steering.

sceneParams.caption: Engine oil pressure: not a steering matter

q25403.en: Steering precision is affected by too high coolant temperature.

explain.short: Coolant temperature is about the engine overheating. It does not change how precisely the car steers.
explain.rule: Steering is precise only if it has no play, the wheels are well aligned and balanced, tyres are at the right pressure and suspension is in good order.
explain.trap: 'liquido di raffreddamento' (coolant) belongs to the engine, not to the steering.

sceneParams.caption: Coolant temperature: not a steering matter

q25404.en: A damaged silencer increases the noise pollution made by motor vehicles.

explain.short: The silencer (marmitta) reduces engine noise. When it is damaged, the vehicle becomes much louder.
explain.rule: A damaged exhaust is replaced with an approved part for that vehicle, in an authorised workshop. Driving without a silencer or tampering with the exhaust is never allowed.
explain.trap: 'inquinamento acustico' means noise pollution, not air pollution.

sceneParams.caption: Damaged silencer: more noise

q25405.en: A damaged silencer must be replaced with another one of an approved type for that type of vehicle.

explain.short: You cannot fit any silencer you like: it must be an approved (omologata) part made for that vehicle.
explain.rule: A damaged exhaust is replaced with an approved part for that vehicle, in an authorised workshop. Driving without a silencer or tampering with the exhaust is never allowed.
explain.trap: 'tipo approvato per quel tipo di veicolo': approved AND for that vehicle, both are needed.

sceneParams.caption: Replace with an approved silencer

q25406.en: The exhaust system carries the exhaust gases outside after lowering their toxicity.

explain.short: The exhaust system (with the catalytic converter) cleans the gases, making them less toxic, before letting them out.
explain.rule: The exhaust takes the gases out of the car after lowering their toxicity, pressure and temperature; it also cuts noise and air pollution.
explain.trap: 'tossicità' (toxicity): lowering it is one of the jobs of the exhaust.

sceneParams.caption: Exhaust lowers the gases' toxicity

q25407.en: The exhaust system carries the exhaust gases outside after lowering their pressure.

explain.short: Gases leave the engine at high pressure. The exhaust slows them down and lowers the pressure, which also cuts the noise.
explain.rule: The exhaust takes the gases out of the car after lowering their toxicity, pressure and temperature; it also cuts noise and air pollution.
explain.trap: 'pressione' (pressure): lowering it is one of the jobs of the exhaust.

sceneParams.caption: Exhaust lowers the gases' pressure

q25408.en: The exhaust system carries the exhaust gases outside after lowering their temperature.

explain.short: Gases leave the engine very hot. Along the exhaust pipe they cool down before going out.
explain.rule: The exhaust takes the gases out of the car after lowering their toxicity, pressure and temperature; it also cuts noise and air pollution.
explain.trap: 'temperatura' (temperature): lowering it is one of the jobs of the exhaust.

sceneParams.caption: Exhaust lowers the gases' temperature

q25409.en: The purpose of the exhaust system is to reduce the vehicle's noise.

explain.short: The silencer is part of the exhaust system, and its job is to make the engine quieter.
explain.rule: The exhaust takes the gases out of the car after lowering their toxicity, pressure and temperature; it also cuts noise and air pollution.
explain.trap: 'rumorosità' means noise: reducing it is a job of the exhaust.

sceneParams.caption: Exhaust reduces noise

q25410.en: The purpose of the exhaust system is to reduce the air pollution caused by the vehicle's exhaust gases.

explain.short: The catalytic converter in the exhaust system cleans the gases, so the vehicle pollutes the air less.
explain.rule: The exhaust takes the gases out of the car after lowering their toxicity, pressure and temperature; it also cuts noise and air pollution.
explain.trap: 'inquinamento atmosferico' is air pollution (smog), different from noise.

sceneParams.caption: Exhaust reduces air pollution

q25411.en: The exhaust system must be completely replaced at every oil change.

explain.short: The exhaust is replaced only when it is damaged or worn, not at every oil change.
explain.rule: A damaged exhaust is replaced with an approved part for that vehicle, in an authorised workshop. Driving without a silencer or tampering with the exhaust is never allowed.
explain.trap: 'integralmente' (completely) and 'a ogni cambio di lubrificante' (at every oil change): nonsense, no such rule.

sceneParams.caption: Oil change: no need to replace the exhaust

q25412.en: The exhaust system of electric vehicles needs more frequent maintenance than that of petrol-engine vehicles.

explain.short: Electric vehicles burn no fuel and have no exhaust system at all, so there is nothing to maintain.
explain.rule: The exhaust takes the gases out of the car after lowering their toxicity, pressure and temperature; it also cuts noise and air pollution.
explain.trap: 'veicoli elettrici' (electric vehicles): they have no exhaust, so the comparison is false.

sceneParams.caption: Electric vehicles: no exhaust at all

q25413.en: Outside built-up areas, vehicles may also be driven without a silencer.

explain.short: A silencer is always required, inside and outside towns. Without it, the vehicle is too noisy and not in order.
explain.rule: A damaged exhaust is replaced with an approved part for that vehicle, in an authorised workshop. Driving without a silencer or tampering with the exhaust is never allowed.
explain.trap: 'Fuori dei centri abitati' (outside towns) changes nothing: the silencer is always compulsory.

sceneParams.caption: Silencer compulsory everywhere

q25414.en: If the silencer's exhaust pipe gets a hole and you do not plan to replace it soon, you can repair it by wrapping it in glass wool and insulating tape.

explain.short: Home-made repairs are not allowed: a damaged exhaust must be replaced with an approved part, without delay.
explain.rule: A damaged exhaust is replaced with an approved part for that vehicle, in an authorised workshop. Driving without a silencer or tampering with the exhaust is never allowed.
explain.trap: 'non si intende sostituirlo a breve' (you don't plan to replace it soon): there is no such option, it must be replaced.

sceneParams.caption: Holed exhaust: replace it, no tape

q25415.en: The exhaust pipe may also be replaced by yourself, without going to an authorised workshop.

explain.short: The quiz expects the exhaust to be replaced by an authorised workshop, so that the part fitted is approved and fitted correctly.
explain.rule: A damaged exhaust is replaced with an approved part for that vehicle, in an authorised workshop. Driving without a silencer or tampering with the exhaust is never allowed.
explain.trap: 'personalmente' (by yourself) is the trap: the official answer wants an authorised workshop.

sceneParams.caption: Exhaust replaced by an authorised workshop

q25415.reviewNote: Official answer FALSE; the Codice does not clearly forbid fitting an approved exhaust part yourself - answer kept as official.

q25416.en: You may modify the exhaust system, as long as you self-certify that this does not increase fuel consumption.

explain.short: Modifying the exhaust is not allowed. A self-declaration about fuel consumption changes nothing.
explain.rule: A damaged exhaust is replaced with an approved part for that vehicle, in an authorised workshop. Driving without a silencer or tampering with the exhaust is never allowed.
explain.trap: 'purché si autocertifichi' (as long as you self-certify): no self-declaration makes a modified exhaust legal.

sceneParams.caption: Modifying the exhaust: not allowed

q25417.en: Tampering with the exhaust system brings no penalty, as long as you drive only in urban areas.

explain.short: Tampering with the exhaust is punished with a fine everywhere, and in towns noise is an even bigger problem.
explain.rule: A damaged exhaust is replaced with an approved part for that vehicle, in an authorised workshop. Driving without a silencer or tampering with the exhaust is never allowed.
explain.trap: 'non comporta alcuna sanzione' (no penalty) and 'solo nei centri urbani' (only in towns) are both wrong.

sceneParams.caption: Tampered exhaust: fined everywhere

q25419.en: On two-wheel motor vehicles, the engine can also be switched off with the emergency switch on the handlebar.

explain.short: The emergency switch (kill switch) on the handlebar stops the engine, as well as the key.
explain.rule: The kill switch is on the handlebar. It stops the engine without taking your hands off the handlebar, and must be on ON to start.
explain.trap: 'anche' (also): the key works, and the handlebar switch works too.

sceneParams.caption: Kill switch on the handlebar stops the engine

q25420.en: On two-wheel motor vehicles, to start the engine the emergency switch on the handlebar must be set to ON/Start.

explain.short: If the kill switch is on OFF, the engine cannot start. It must be on ON/RUN.
explain.rule: The kill switch is on the handlebar. It stops the engine without taking your hands off the handlebar, and must be on ON to start.
explain.trap: 'necessario' (necessary): with the switch on OFF the bike will not start.

sceneParams.caption: Kill switch on ON to start

q25421.en: On two-wheel motor vehicles, the emergency switch lets you stop the engine without taking your hands off the handlebar.

explain.short: The switch is right next to the grip, so you can press it with your thumb and keep both hands on the handlebar.
explain.rule: The kill switch is on the handlebar. It stops the engine without taking your hands off the handlebar, and must be on ON to start.
explain.trap: 'senza staccare le mani' (without taking hands off): this is the reason it is on the handlebar.

sceneParams.caption: Stop the engine, hands on the handlebar

q25422.en: On two-wheel motor vehicles, the emergency switch lets you stop the engine if you stop on very steep roads with your hands busy on the control levers.

explain.short: On a steep slope your hands hold the brake and clutch levers. The kill switch lets you stop the engine without letting go.
explain.rule: The kill switch is on the handlebar. It stops the engine without taking your hands off the handlebar, and must be on ON to start.
explain.trap: 'forti pendenze' (steep slopes) with 'mani occupate' (hands busy): a typical use of the switch.

sceneParams.caption: Steep slope, hands busy: use the kill switch

q25423.en: The emergency switch fitted on two-wheel motor vehicles must be repaired as soon as possible if it is broken.

explain.short: The kill switch is a safety device. If it does not work, have it repaired soon.
explain.rule: The kill switch is on the handlebar. It stops the engine without taking your hands off the handlebar, and must be on ON to start.
explain.trap: 'al più presto' (as soon as possible): a safety device must not stay broken.

sceneParams.caption: Broken kill switch: repair it soon
lines: Repair it as soon as possible

q25424.en: On a motorcycle, to switch off the engine in normal situations, it is better to use the ignition key rather than the emergency switch.

explain.short: The kill switch is for emergencies. Normally you switch off with the key, which also turns off the electrics.
explain.rule: The kill switch is on the handlebar. It stops the engine without taking your hands off the handlebar, and must be on ON to start.
explain.trap: 'situazioni ordinarie' (normal situations): then the key is preferred.

sceneParams.caption: Normally: switch off with the key

q25425.en: On two-wheel motor vehicles, the emergency switch on the handlebar replaces the key ignition.

explain.short: The kill switch only stops the engine. You still need the key to switch on the bike.
explain.rule: The kill switch is on the handlebar. It stops the engine without taking your hands off the handlebar, and must be on ON to start.
explain.trap: 'sostituisce' (replaces) is wrong: the switch works together with the key.

sceneParams.caption: Kill switch does not replace the key

q25426.en: To make stopping the engine easier, two-wheel motor vehicles have an emergency switch on the gear pedal.

explain.short: The kill switch is on the handlebar, near the right grip, not on the gear pedal.
explain.rule: The kill switch is on the handlebar. It stops the engine without taking your hands off the handlebar, and must be on ON to start.
explain.trap: 'pedivella del cambio' (gear pedal) is the wrong place: it is on the handlebar.

sceneParams.caption: Kill switch: on the handlebar, not the pedal
lines: Switch on the gear pedal: no

q25427.en: On two-wheel motor vehicles, the emergency switch locks the wheels instantly.

explain.short: The kill switch only stops the engine. It does not brake or lock the wheels; locking the wheels would be dangerous.
explain.rule: The kill switch is on the handlebar. It stops the engine without taking your hands off the handlebar, and must be on ON to start.
explain.trap: 'blocco istantaneo delle ruote' (instant wheel lock) is wrong: it only cuts the engine.

sceneParams.caption: Kill switch stops the engine, not the wheels

q25428.en: The emergency switch on the side stand is for switching off the motorcycle's engine on sloping roads.

explain.short: The emergency switch is on the handlebar, not on the side stand. It is used when you cannot let go of the levers.
explain.rule: The kill switch is on the handlebar. It stops the engine without taking your hands off the handlebar, and must be on ON to start.
explain.trap: 'posto sul cavalletto laterale' (on the side stand) is the wrong place.

sceneParams.caption: Kill switch: on the handlebar, not the stand
lines: Switch on the side stand: no

q25429.en: To make stopping the engine easier, two-wheel motor vehicles have an emergency switch operated by pressing with the right foot.

explain.short: The kill switch is pressed with the thumb on the handlebar, not with the foot (the right foot works the rear brake).
explain.rule: The kill switch is on the handlebar. It stops the engine without taking your hands off the handlebar, and must be on ON to start.
explain.trap: 'pressione del piede destro' (right foot) is wrong: it is a hand switch on the handlebar.

sceneParams.caption: Kill switch: by hand, not by foot

q25430.en: On two-wheel motor vehicles, the emergency switch works as a parking brake.

explain.short: The kill switch only stops the engine. It does not hold the bike still like a parking brake.
explain.rule: The kill switch is on the handlebar. It stops the engine without taking your hands off the handlebar, and must be on ON to start.
explain.trap: 'freno di stazionamento' (parking brake) is wrong: the switch has nothing to do with brakes.

sceneParams.caption: Kill switch is not a parking brake

q25431.en: On two-wheel motor vehicles, the emergency switch is connected to the vehicle's anti-theft device.

explain.short: The kill switch is only for stopping the engine quickly. It is not part of the anti-theft system.
explain.rule: The kill switch is on the handlebar. It stops the engine without taking your hands off the handlebar, and must be on ON to start.
explain.trap: 'collegato con l'antifurto' (connected to the anti-theft) is wrong.

sceneParams.caption: Kill switch is not an anti-theft device

q25432.en: For road safety, on two-wheel motor vehicles you should regularly check the wear of the drive chain.

explain.short: A worn chain can slip or break, which is dangerous. Checking its wear regularly is part of safe maintenance.
explain.rule: Check the drive chain regularly: wear, tension and lubrication. A worn chain is replaced; a broken chain can lock the rear wheel.
explain.trap: 'usura' (wear): a worn chain is a safety risk.

sceneParams.caption: Check chain wear regularly

q25433.en: The drive chain of two-wheel motor vehicles can break if it is not lubricated.

explain.short: A dry chain wears quickly and can break. It needs regular lubrication.
explain.rule: Check the drive chain regularly: wear, tension and lubrication. A worn chain is replaced; a broken chain can lock the rear wheel.
explain.trap: 'se non lubrificata' (if not lubricated): lack of oil is the cause of the break.

sceneParams.caption: Dry chain can break

q25434.en: On two-wheel motor vehicles, the drive chain links the engine sprocket to the wheel sprocket.

explain.short: The chain carries the engine's power: from the small sprocket on the engine (pignone) to the big one on the rear wheel (corona).
explain.rule: Check the drive chain regularly: wear, tension and lubrication. A worn chain is replaced; a broken chain can lock the rear wheel.
explain.trap: 'pignone' is the small engine sprocket, 'corona' the big wheel sprocket.

sceneParams.caption: Chain: engine sprocket to wheel sprocket

q25435.en: For safety, on two-wheel motor vehicles you should regularly check that the drive chain is well lubricated.

explain.short: A well lubricated chain lasts longer and does not break. Check it regularly.
explain.rule: Check the drive chain regularly: wear, tension and lubrication. A worn chain is replaced; a broken chain can lock the rear wheel.
explain.trap: 'ben lubrificata' (well lubricated): this is what you check.

sceneParams.caption: Check the chain is well lubricated

q25436.en: On two-wheel motor vehicles, you should regularly check the correct tension of the drive chain.

explain.short: A chain that is too loose can jump off; too tight, it wears out and can break. Check the tension regularly.
explain.rule: Check the drive chain regularly: wear, tension and lubrication. A worn chain is replaced; a broken chain can lock the rear wheel.
explain.trap: 'tensione' (tension): neither too loose nor too tight.

sceneParams.caption: Check the chain tension regularly
lines: Chain too loose or too tight

q25437.en: On two-wheel motor vehicles, a sudden break of the drive chain can lock the rear wheel, with loss of control of the vehicle.

explain.short: A broken chain can wrap around the rear sprocket and block the rear wheel, and the rider can fall.
explain.rule: Check the drive chain regularly: wear, tension and lubrication. A worn chain is replaced; a broken chain can lock the rear wheel.
explain.trap: 'bloccaggio della ruota posteriore' (rear wheel lock): this is why a chain break is dangerous.

sceneParams.caption: Broken chain: rear wheel can lock

q25438.en: On two-wheel motor vehicles, if the drive chain shows signs of wear, it must be replaced.

explain.short: A worn chain is not repaired: it is replaced with a new one.
explain.rule: Check the drive chain regularly: wear, tension and lubrication. A worn chain is replaced; a broken chain can lock the rear wheel.
explain.trap: 'sostituirla' (replace it): the only correct fix for a worn chain.

sceneParams.caption: Worn chain: replace it

q25439.en: On two-wheel motor vehicles, the drive chain needs no lubrication because it is made of self-lubricating steel.

explain.short: Drive chains are not self-lubricating: they must be lubricated regularly.
explain.rule: Check the drive chain regularly: wear, tension and lubrication. A worn chain is replaced; a broken chain can lock the rear wheel.
explain.trap: 'acciaio autolubrificante' (self-lubricating steel) does not exist for drive chains.

sceneParams.caption: The chain needs lubrication

q25440.en: On two-wheel motor vehicles, a broken drive chain affects the riding speed, but not safety.

explain.short: A broken chain can lock the rear wheel and make you fall, so it is a serious safety problem.
explain.rule: Check the drive chain regularly: wear, tension and lubrication. A worn chain is replaced; a broken chain can lock the rear wheel.
explain.trap: 'ma non la sicurezza' (but not safety) is wrong: safety is exactly what is at risk.

sceneParams.caption: Broken chain: a safety danger

q25441.en: On two-wheel motor vehicles, if the drive chain shows signs of wear, it must be reinforced with suitable iron wire.

explain.short: A worn chain must be replaced, never repaired with wire.
explain.rule: Check the drive chain regularly: wear, tension and lubrication. A worn chain is replaced; a broken chain can lock the rear wheel.
explain.trap: 'rinforzarla con filo di ferro' (reinforce it with iron wire) is a dangerous home repair.

sceneParams.caption: Worn chain: replace, no iron wire

q25442.en: On two-wheel motor vehicles, when the drive chain is replaced because of wear, it is never necessary to replace the engine sprocket and the wheel sprocket too.

explain.short: Chain and sprockets wear together. Often they must be replaced together, so 'never' is wrong.
explain.rule: Check the drive chain regularly: wear, tension and lubrication. A worn chain is replaced; a broken chain can lock the rear wheel.
explain.trap: 'mai' (never) is the trap: often the sprockets must be changed too.

sceneParams.caption: New chain: often new sprockets too

q25443.en: On two-wheel motor vehicles, there is no need to check the tension of the drive chain regularly, because it has an automatic tensioner.

explain.short: Drive chains must have their tension checked and adjusted regularly; they do not adjust themselves.
explain.rule: Check the drive chain regularly: wear, tension and lubrication. A worn chain is replaced; a broken chain can lock the rear wheel.
explain.trap: 'tenditore automatico' (automatic tensioner) is the false excuse.

sceneParams.caption: Chain tension must be checked

q25444.en: On two-wheel motor vehicles, the drive chain must be cleaned with degreasing detergent, but absolutely not lubricated, so the gearbox does not slip.

explain.short: The chain must be cleaned AND lubricated. Lubrication has nothing to do with the gearbox slipping.
explain.rule: Check the drive chain regularly: wear, tension and lubrication. A worn chain is replaced; a broken chain can lock the rear wheel.
explain.trap: 'assolutamente non lubrificata' (absolutely not lubricated) is the opposite of the truth.

sceneParams.caption: Clean and lubricate the chain

q25445.en: On two-wheel motor vehicles, you may replace the engine sprocket and the wheel sprocket in order to change the transmission ratio.

explain.short: Changing the sprockets to alter the ratio changes the approved vehicle (its speed and performance), which is not allowed.
explain.rule: Check the drive chain regularly: wear, tension and lubrication. A worn chain is replaced; a broken chain can lock the rear wheel.
explain.trap: 'modificare il rapporto di trasmissione' (change the ratio): a modification of the approved vehicle.

sceneParams.caption: Changing the gear ratio: not allowed

q25446.en: On two-wheel motor vehicles, the oil level must be checked with the vehicle perfectly upright, standing on its wheels and not on the stand.

explain.short: On the side stand the bike leans and the oil moves, so the reading is wrong. Check it upright, with both wheels on the ground.
explain.rule: Check engine oil and brake fluid regularly. Oil: bike upright and level, wheels on the ground, engine off for a few minutes.
explain.trap: 'non sul cavalletto' (not on the stand): on the stand the bike leans and the level is wrong.

sceneParams.caption: Check oil with the bike upright

q25447.en: On motorcycles you must regularly check the levels of engine oil and brake fluid.

explain.short: Too little oil damages the engine; too little brake fluid makes the brakes fail. Check both regularly.
explain.rule: Check engine oil and brake fluid regularly. Oil: bike upright and level, wheels on the ground, engine off for a few minutes.
explain.trap: 'olio motore e liquido freni' (engine oil and brake fluid): both have levels to check.

sceneParams.caption: Check oil and brake fluid regularly

q25448.en: On motorcycles, the brake fluid level is checked by looking at the special transparent reservoir.

explain.short: The brake fluid is in a small clear reservoir, usually on the handlebar, with marks for the right level.
explain.rule: Check engine oil and brake fluid regularly. Oil: bike upright and level, wheels on the ground, engine off for a few minutes.
explain.trap: 'vaschetta trasparente' (transparent reservoir): you can see the level through it.

sceneParams.caption: Brake fluid: look at the clear reservoir

q25449.en: In some motorcycle engines, the engine oil level can be checked through a special small window on the sump.

explain.short: Some engines have a small glass window on the sump (the oil pan at the bottom) to see the oil level.
explain.rule: Check engine oil and brake fluid regularly. Oil: bike upright and level, wheels on the ground, engine off for a few minutes.
explain.trap: 'In alcuni' (in some): not all engines, but some have this window.

sceneParams.caption: Some engines: oil window on the sump

q25450.en: On motorcycles, the oil level is checked with the vehicle on level ground and after the engine has been off for a few minutes.

explain.short: After a few minutes the oil flows back down to the sump, and on level ground the reading is correct.
explain.rule: Check engine oil and brake fluid regularly. Oil: bike upright and level, wheels on the ground, engine off for a few minutes.
explain.trap: 'dopo aver spento il motore da alcuni minuti' (engine off for a few minutes): not with the engine running.

sceneParams.caption: Oil: level ground, engine off a few minutes

q25451.en: On two-wheel motor vehicles, there are no fluids whose levels need checking, because the tanks are sealed.

explain.short: Motorbikes have engine oil and brake fluid (and some coolant) that must be checked regularly.
explain.rule: Check engine oil and brake fluid regularly. Oil: bike upright and level, wheels on the ground, engine off for a few minutes.
explain.trap: 'serbatoi sigillati' (sealed tanks) is false: the levels must be checked.

sceneParams.caption: Motorbike fluids must be checked

q25452.en: On motorcycles, the engine oil level must be checked with the engine running at idle and the bike on the stand.

explain.short: Oil is checked with the engine OFF for a few minutes and the bike upright, not on the stand.
explain.rule: Check engine oil and brake fluid regularly. Oil: bike upright and level, wheels on the ground, engine off for a few minutes.
explain.trap: 'motore in funzione al minimo' (engine idling) and 'sul cavalletto' (on the stand) are both wrong.

sceneParams.caption: Oil: engine off, bike upright

q25453.en: Motorcycles have no brake fluid reservoir because their braking is purely mechanical.

explain.short: Most motorcycles have hydraulic brakes with a brake fluid reservoir that must be checked.
explain.rule: Check engine oil and brake fluid regularly. Oil: bike upright and level, wheels on the ground, engine off for a few minutes.
explain.trap: 'puramente meccanico' (purely mechanical) is wrong: motorbike brakes are hydraulic.

sceneParams.caption: Motorbike brakes are hydraulic

q25454.en: On air-cooled motorcycles, the coolant level can be checked through a special small window between the engine fins.

explain.short: An air-cooled engine is cooled by air through its fins. It has no coolant liquid, so there is no level to check.
explain.rule: Check engine oil and brake fluid regularly. Oil: bike upright and level, wheels on the ground, engine off for a few minutes.
explain.trap: 'raffreddati ad aria' (air-cooled): no coolant liquid at all.

sceneParams.caption: Air-cooled engine: no coolant
